Subject: Changes to On-Call Rotation Starting June 2

Hi team,

Starting June 2, on-call shifts will last 3 days instead of a full week.

Many of you have told us that week-long shifts are exhausting, especially when incidents pile up late in the week. Shorter shifts should mean less fatigue and steadier response quality from start to finish. They should also make it easier to plan your personal time.

With 9 engineers in the rotation pool, each of you will be on call about once every 27 days. That's more often than before, but each shift is much shorter. You'll also get a $150 bonus for each shift you complete.

We'll post the updated schedule in the team calendar by the end of next week, so please check your dates once it's up. If you have a conflict, arrange a swap with a teammate and tell your manager at least 48 hours before the shift starts.

If you have questions or concerns, reply to this email or bring them to our next team sync.

Thanks for keeping our systems running smoothly.

Best,
[Your Name]
Engineering Operations
